name: stock-tracker-agent
notes: No test suite and no CI (README only; Dockerfile python:3.12-slim), so test_cmd is a smoke check: compileall of the whole repo, then import lib.sms, lib.tools, lib.agent (asserts the three openai-agents Agent objects and both entry coroutines exist), lib.tracker and main (asserts the FastAPI app), with dummy OpenAI/Twilio env. main.py's uvicorn.run is behind __main__, so importing it starts nothing. Deps: requirements.txt (unpinned) resolved with --exclude-newer 2026-10-13 into a Python 3.12 uv venv; not a package, so no reinstall step (cwd = the copy puts it on sys.path). Twilio client.messages.create in lib/sms.py is an SMS call, not an LLM site.
